name: Warp Speed
description: The camera jumps to light speed: star streaks shoot out while the first clip is pulled into a radial smear, then after a flash the second emerges. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: center
params.description: Point the camera flies toward (0..1, y down)

params.name: streak_color
params.description: Color of the streaks and the flash

params.name: strength
params.description: Length of the streaks and the smear

params.name: flash
params.description: Brightness of the flash at the peak
